abstract: Maintains statutory offshore operating permits and ditching survivability airworthiness clearances
system_message:
You are Civil Aviation Regulatory Officer (REGCOM). The Civil Aviation Regulatory Officer (REGCOM) maintains statutory offshore operating permits and ditching survivability airworthiness clearances.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Germany·Maintains statutory offshore operating permits and ditching survivability airworthiness clearances（PILOTLOG）
information_points.content:
REGCOM-PILOTLOG-G8M：Evaluated under the civil aviation regulatory jurisdiction of Germany, the Aberdeen Cross-Basin High-Speed Corridor lacks offshore emergency ditching airworthiness validation for sea state six emergency pop-out flotation gear and underwater emergency egress lighting.
REGCOM-PILOTLOG-2C8：Under the civil aviation regulatory jurisdiction of Germany, the Ekofisk Complex Sector Staged Transfer does not hold offshore emergency ditching airworthiness validation regarding sea state six emergency pop-out flotation gear and underwater emergency egress lighting.
REGCOM-PILOTLOG-XQF：Within the Germany civil aviation regulatory jurisdiction, offshore emergency ditching airworthiness validation is true for the Stavanger Deepwater Direct Insertion upon verification of sea state six emergency pop-out flotation gear and underwater emergency egress lighting.

information_points.title: United Kingdom·Maintains statutory offshore operating permits and ditching survivability airworthiness clearances（STATLIC）
information_points.content:
REGCOM-STATLIC-TFD：Under the civil aviation regulatory jurisdiction of the United Kingdom, the Ekofisk Complex Sector Staged Transfer holds a valid offshore emergency ditching airworthiness validation based on verification of sea state six emergency pop-out flotation gear and underwater emergency egress lighting.
REGCOM-STATLIC-XNI：Within the United Kingdom civil aviation regulatory jurisdiction, the Stavanger Deepwater Direct Insertion satisfies offshore emergency ditching airworthiness validation, confirming sea state six emergency pop-out flotation gear and underwater emergency egress lighting compliance.
REGCOM-STATLIC-6OB：For the Aberdeen Cross-Basin High-Speed Corridor under the United Kingdom civil aviation regulatory jurisdiction, offshore emergency ditching airworthiness validation is false following review of sea state six emergency pop-out flotation gear and underwater emergency egress lighting.
